name: IGNATIUS FRAME
walkToNote: WHERE THAD STANDS TO TALK TO HIM: on the floor before the desk, facing him at his press (errata 82 C): talkers by furniture, not on open floor (doc 55 section 8).
note: IGNATIUS FRAME, editor and sole employee of the Clarion (doc 01; doc 04: 'enthusiastic, amoral, and permanently mid-sentence'). Canon gives him no appearance, so he is a wiry 1850s printer-editor -- rolled sleeves, an ink-stained apron, a pencil behind his ear (errata 82 B). Drawn first in room-09's composition master at his press beside Thad (style gate step 1), then alone on magenta in five poses (room-09 operation 3), keyed by tools/art/room09-frame.py. He stands at his press, at the room's curve. Room 9 is his first drawing and so his canonical design (doc 38 section 1).
barksNote: Doc 07 writes no barks for Frame.

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest · 1 breath (derived from rest by tools/rig/ambient-breath.py) · 2 talking, a hand out · 3 taking a quote in his notebook · 4 leaning in. Breathing on 0 and 1 at `rate`; every `breakEvery` seconds one break from the pool (errata 35, 77: a deliberate action at least every 30 s).
